summary: Teardown of an AVI playback struct at a2 (with a1 as the sentinel value to test against). If the resource pointer at a2+68 (0x44) differs from a1 it is released via sub_53CB90 and the field is reset to a1; if the pointer at a2+80 (0x50) differs from a1 it is freed via FreeWrapper_7bcf and reset to a1. The struct is then zero-initialized by WideStructZeroInit(a2) and the AVI file system is shut down with AVIFileExit().

local_names.a1: sentinel value the resource pointers are compared against before release
local_names.a2: pointer to the AVI player struct being torn down

operations.description: Guard: only release the resource at a2+68 when its value differs from the sentinel a1.
Release the resource at offset +68 (0x44) via sub_53CB90.
Reset a2+68 to the sentinel a1 after the release.
Guard: only free the pointer at a2+80 when its value differs from the sentinel a1.
Free the heap resource at offset +80 (0x50) via FreeWrapper_7bcf.
Reset a2+80 to the sentinel a1 after the free.
Zero-initialize the playback struct a2 via WideStructZeroInit.
Shut down the AVI file system via AVIFileExit().
